description:
Sacrifice Tenacious Dead to Ashnod's Altar, generating {2}.
Pitiless Plunderer, Mayhem Devil, and Tenacious Dead trigger; stack the triggers to resolve in that order.
Pitiless Plunderer generates a Treasure token; crack it to float {B}.
Mayhem Devil triggers again.
Both Mayhem Devil triggers deals 1 damage each to an opponent for 2 damage.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying{1} {B} to return it to the battlefield from the graveyard.
Repeat the sacrifice-recursion loop inflicting damage to opponent infinitely with Mayhem Devil triggers.
